findings.detail: Angles: reuse, simplification and efficiency. run() rebuilds declarations(manifest) for execution after constructing result rows; verified() rebuilds it after checking declaration order. Each redundant call allocates three lists and one tuple per declaration. Neither function changes the declarations between calls. Disposition: skipped because this run prohibits edits.
findings.fix: Store declarations(manifest) in a local variable within each function and reuse it for that function's existing consumers. Preserve validation order, strict zip checks and independent render verification.
findings.title: Uncited: Reuse each function's ordered declaration list.

strengths: Execution, evidence verification and publication have useful separate boundaries.
